name: Kahalgaon
source: Government of Bihar Directorate of Land Records & Survey BhuNaksha Bihar public cadastral viewer

queries.query: Kahalgaon Bihar official cadastral parcel map land records GIS site:gov.in
queries.result: Found the official Bihar BhuNaksha viewer, Bhagalpur district land-records page, and Bhagalpur official map/subdivision pages. The local parcel viewer is the strongest first-party route; no separate Kahalgaon municipal parcel API was identified.

queries.query: बिहार आधिकारिक भू-नक्शा खसरा नक्शा Kahalgaon कहलगांव
queries.result: Found the official Bihar BhuNaksha and Bihar Bhumi routes. The Hindi discovery confirms Kahalgaon as a Bihar land-records location, but did not identify a distinct public Kahalgaon municipal parcel endpoint.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar; NIC BhuNaksha Bihar
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Bihar cadastral map viewer with district, subdivision, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance, and sheet selectors
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official viewer shell loaded and its current JavaScript/configuration exposed anonymous REST and WMS routes. This is a real state cadastral viewer, but a Kahalgaon town polygon was not independently obtained.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Bhagalpur District Administration, Government of Bihar
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official district page links to Bihar land records. It is custodian/procedure evidence, not a parcel feature response.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Bhagalpur District Administration, Government of Bihar
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page identifies Kahalgaon subdivision and Kahalgaon block. This supports local administrative scope, not parcel geometry coverage.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official viewer HTML loaded. Current scripts referenced assets/misc/config.js and index.js.
Current configuration exposes the public service base and OpenLayers/WMS viewer setup.

Current JavaScript exposes rest/Levels/count, rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel, rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref, rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, ScalarDatahandler, and WMS routes. No login or private token was used.
Bihar state hierarchy has seven configured levels.
Returned the Bihar district list; Bhagalpur is code 22.

Returned Kahalgaon subdivision code 03, Kahalgaon circle code 15, and a public mauza list. The inspected list did not include a village value named Kahalgaon; it included nearby/related named mauzas and survey selectors.
Returned Kahalgaon circle and its mauza list, including native mauza codes such as 1438 for Abdullanagar; no Kahalgaon town parcel feature was returned.
A valid mauza/survey/map selection is required before this extent route can be meaningfully called. No extent miss is inferred and the WUP point was not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bihar state BhuNaksha cadastral viewer with Bhagalpur/Kahalgaon administrative selectors.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official viewer, current REST route names, Bihar/Bhagalpur/Kahalgaon hierarchy, and public mauza/survey metadata only.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Government of Bihar cadastral viewer and Bhagalpur district land-records custodian are evidenced.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: Not assessed; no parcel feature geometry was returned.
qualityAssessment.crs: Viewer JavaScript passes srs=0 to the extent route and uses WMS, but no parcel feature response declared a CRS. CRS is therefore unqualified.
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: Not qualified; mauza codes are visible metadata but no stable parcel identity plus geometry response was obtained.
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: No parcel attributes were requested. Owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, and document fields were not requested or retained.

blocker: Serial review must independently qualify a live anonymous Kahalgaon parcel response, stable native identity semantics, geometry/CRS handling, and safe field behavior before runtime use.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [25.253567663983,87.2516224372473] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
No retained GeoJSON sample because no safe native parcel feature with full polygon geometry and identity was obtained.
The official state viewer and district pages establish cadastral/administrative custodianship, but not citywide Kahalgaon parcel coverage.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception used.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON was retained. If later obtained, retain exactly one stable native parcel identity in properties.id; keep native field mapping and any composite-key provenance in city/service-review metadata.
